$comment: Prompts with the tier each should land on, for the calibrate example:
The labels are judgements, not ground truth: each follows Anthropic's positioning of the models and the
published per-task benchmarks noted in rust/src/config.rs. Revisit them when a new model changes what a tier
is good at, and say why in the commit. Keep both sides of every boundary covered, since a guidance change
that pulls one tier's work in tends to push its neighbour's out.
